name: Midas Fasanara Global Euro
reason: Positive identity/structure/exit assessment with material caveats: Ethereum token and registered redemption vault are matched by official sources and read-only calls. The euro-denominated Fasanara credit exposure and issuer-operated standard/capacity-limited instant redemption are documented. Approval does not imply guaranteed liquidity, principal protection or eligibility for every holder.
redeem: The official product and registry identify a dedicated Ethereum redemption vault. Standard redemption depends on offchain settlement and NAV updates; instant redemption depends on fees, approved payment assets, available capacity and controls. Investor eligibility, screening, pauses and strategy-manager funding can delay or prevent an exit. There is no unconditional immediate EUR redemption guarantee.
notes: Official product describes a euro-denominated claim linked to Fasanara Global Diversified Alternative Debt and names Aureum Securitisation Fund, Compartment mGLOeuro, as issuer. This is investment/credit exposure, not a euro stablecoin. Midas contracts implement role-controlled mint/burn, blacklist and pause controls, admin-fulfilled requests and limits. Token and registered vault paused() were false at observation; this is not assurance about future availability. No real-wallet call, redemption transaction, live quote, offchain reserve verification or independent audit conclusion was made.
